correctness.rationale: For arbitrary finite field and n≥2, images e_r are forced by successive squaring of f(e1). The mixed relation e1·e_{d+1}=0 forces a_j a_i^(2^d)=0 for each i<j<n, so one non-annihilator coefficient at most. Conversely the two displayed families satisfy every relation. Their coordinate pivots give complete ranks. Nonunits strictly raise the terminal flag and n-fold products vanish; an explicit shift survives n−1 products. The only idempotents and regular elements then follow. The standalone verifier performs direct enumeration, finite-field elimination and composition in 19 small cases, not as a proof of the infinite statement.

value.rationale: The canonical chain is a natural representative of maximal-nilindex evolution algebras, and complete self-map structure is mathematically motivated beyond the known unit group. Uniform exact rank multiplicities in arbitrary dimension and field size, a sharp nilpotent nonunit ideal and the lack of proper retractions or nonunit regular maps determine intrinsic semigroup invariants, not arbitrary instances or a routine renaming of an automorphism theorem.
